The issuer has reasonable balance-sheet strength with moderate leverage (total liabilities of 689M vs. total assets of 1,154M) and solid near-term liquidity (current ratio ≈ 1.50). However, profitability appears modest for the revenue base (net margin ≈ 4.3% and EBIT margin ≈ 7.3%), limiting cushion against downturns. Overall, this supports a lower-investment-grade profile rather than a stronger rating tier.

DECISION: BBB-
